exposure: induction of labor at 39 weeks gestation
expectant management at 39 weeks of gestation
cohort: 408 nulliparous women at 39 weeks gestation or more
finding: Induction of labor at 39 weeks gestation in nulliparous women did not increase the risk of cesarean delivery and resulted in similar maternal and neonatal outcomes compared to expectant management.
mod_finding: The study found that induction of labor (IOL) at 39 weeks of gestation in nulliparous women did not significantly increase the risk of cesarean delivery compared to expectant management.
